name: Rajbir Karan Verma
summary: Senior Ruby on Rails Developer with 13+ years of experience building and maintaining production SaaS applications. Own API architecture and database design for partner-facing shipping systems, and build software that helps operations teams enforce U.S. customs requirements.

accomplishments.title: Shipment compliance review
accomplishments.text: Built a compliance review workflow for U.S.-bound shipments with vague descriptions, incorrect or mismatched HTS codes, or discrepancies in declared value. Staff can request corrections or supporting documents, and shipments with open reviews are blocked at carrier release until staff approve them.
accomplishments.portfolioText: Staff can ask customers to clarify product descriptions, correct tariff codes, or provide invoices to verify declared values. Shipments with open reviews are held until staff approve them.

accomplishments.title: Tariff calculation engine
accomplishments.text: Designed a tariff engine that turns regulatory rules into formulas evaluated at runtime. Built a service that determines which inputs the shipping form needs and verified the calculated duties against manual calculations.
accomplishments.portfolioText: The shipping form asks for the details required to calculate U.S. duties upfront. The tariff engine applies the relevant rules, with results checked against manual calculations.

accomplishments.title: Partner-facing shipping API
accomplishments.text: Owned API architecture and database design for a partner-facing REST API covering shipment creation, rates, labels, tracking, and account management.
accomplishments.portfolioText: Shipping partners can create shipments, get rates, generate labels, and track packages directly from their own platforms.

accomplishments.text: Designed and built a Rails framework that determines which postage products a shipment qualifies for, then calculates rates for the eligible options.
Implemented two-factor authentication using SMS verification and authenticator apps.

Built and tested an AI-assisted pull request reviewer using examples from past reviews. Verified edge cases it surfaced by checking ticket requirements, reproducing the behaviour locally, and confirming it with tests.
Mentor developers through code reviews and pair programming. Maintain production Rails applications through framework and dependency upgrades, automated testing, refactoring, and troubleshooting.

experience.portfolioSummary: Designs partner APIs and builds the Rails systems behind carrier integrations, postage pricing, and customs reviews. Helps set technical direction and mentors developers through code review and pairing.

accomplishments.text: Developed and supported the bilingual TD Summer Reading Club application using multiple Rails Engines, maintaining and evolving the platform during a period of more than 150% growth in website traffic.

Led full-stack development of the TPL Kids website and content management system, working directly with stakeholders and management to define requirements, technical solutions, and implementation priorities.
Maintained and enhanced tpl.ca, delivering new functionality, troubleshooting production issues, and improving existing features across the library's public-facing platform.
Rebuilt the Live Searches Dashboard using Ruby on Rails and Vue.js, providing real-time visibility into search activity on tpl.ca.

experience.portfolioSummary: Led development of the TPL Kids website and its content management system. Helped maintain the bilingual TD Summer Reading Club site.

Worked directly with clients to gather requirements, define user stories, and translate business needs into technical solutions.

Developed and customized WordPress themes to support client websites and business requirements.
